texts: How our feature reels are filmed: a scripted test run against the live site

The feature videos in this feed are scripted test runs against the live site, filmed as they run. If any step fails, there is no video and the feature is not announced. The page clock is stepped one frame at a time, 1/30 of a second each, so a heavy 3D page films smoothly on a machine with no GPU. Here is how the camera works, and what it refuses to film.
